description: This source file contains Google Test unit tests for the HdcpProfile plugin, specifically testing its capabilities to report HDCP status, handle support queries, and respond to HDMI connection and HDCP status events, using mock objects and Google Test framework.

classes.name: HDCPProfileTest
classes.description: Base test fixture class for HdcpProfile plugin. Initializes plugin, handler, connection, and provides basic setup/teardown.

classes.name: HDCPProfileDsTest
classes.description: Derived fixture for testing HdcpProfile with mock device implementations and display connections.

classes.name: HDCPProfileEventTest
classes.description: Further derives for testing event handling via plugin dispatchers and services.

classes.name: HDCPProfileEventIarmTest
classes.description: Specialized test fixture for simulating IARM bus events and testing HDCP status change reactions.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test that verifies the plugin handler exposes getHDCPStatus and getSettopHDCPSupport methods.

methods.name: getHDCPStatus_isConnected_false
methods.description: Test that checks the HDCP status response when display is disconnected.

methods.name: getHDCPStatus_isConnected_true
methods.description: Test that checks the HDCP status response when display is connected and authenticated.

methods.name: getSettopHDCPSupport_Hdcp_v1x
methods.description: Test that queries support when HDCP protocol version is 1.x.

methods.name: getSettopHDCPSupport_Hdcp_v2x
methods.description: Test that queries support when HDCP protocol version is 2.x.

methods.name: onDisplayConnectionChanged
methods.description: Test event handler for HDMI display connection change, verifying JSON event message.

methods.name: onHdmiOutputHDCPStatusEvent
methods.description: Test event handler for HDMI HDCP status change, verifying JSON event message.
